moods.name: Sunflower Desktop
moods.description: Loud yellow held in place by a calm blue and a hard black line. Use the dark sparingly and it sings.

moods.name: Cold Brew & Cream
moods.description: Four browns pretending to be a full palette. Warm, quiet, and forgiving of mistakes.

moods.name: Window Light, 9 AM
moods.description: Pale and green and slightly sleepy. Good for anything drawn from life.

moods.name: Risograph Accident
moods.description: Three inks that shouldn't overlap and absolutely should. Let the edges misregister.

moods.name: Paper Scraps
moods.description: The palette of the bottom of the supply crate. Muted, tactile, endlessly stackable.

moods.name: Late Night Studio
moods.description: Dark ground, one warm light source. Everything you draw looks more serious than it is.

moods.name: Neighborhood Awning
moods.description: Storefront colors. Cheerful without being childish, if you keep the shapes flat.
